comments.author: DBravo
comments.body: Found a couple of these that were discarded in Seville while using random Search. Not sure where they come from but they are an active item in the game.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Part of the Bravery and Pride Memorial Album, related to Battle Campaign activities. It comes from a variety of Battle Performance Award items and can be selected manually if you should obtain the appropriate award. Additional info can be found on the Album page. Cheers.

Source: gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?BattleCampaign
